look_here_first: Inspect alternate cauline toothed leaves on tall branched stems, then a rayless head with 8–12 florets and blunt to shortly acute phyllaries. Unlike A. runcinata, the leaves are not a deeply lobed basal rosette.

key_traits.label: Leaves
key_traits.text: Alternate cauline elliptic/lanceolate leaves, dentate margins, sometimes clasping.

key_traits.label: Heads
key_traits.text: Clustered rayless heads, generally 8–12 disk florets; phyllaries blunt to shortly acute.

key_traits.label: Habit
key_traits.text: Branched leafy perennial, usually 30–150 cm; brown woolly basal hairs possible.
